name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Enablement & Cross-Functional Initiative Leader | Go-to-Market, Channel Enablement & Team Leadership
summary: Operations and enablement leader with 15+ years turning broad direction into structured plans, ready teams, and measurable results. At Wix, I led a team of 20 (later 8) and helped take a new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line, building the process, training, and data standards it ran on. At Birdeye, I enabled a channel of 15-20 reseller partners to sell and support the product, retaining all but one. As a founder and co-owner, I've built operations and compliance systems from nothing in a state-regulated business. I work well in ambiguity, keep leaders informed on risks and tradeoffs, and know which calls to make and which to escalate.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run discovery with business owners to structure loosely defined goals into scoped plans, milestones, and measures of success.
Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with owners and sales teams, and report progress with recommendations on a regular cadence.
Build repeatable, scalable systems (20+ automated workflows, reusable templates and frameworks) that improve execution across every engagement.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' ideas into precise requirements for technical builds, bridging business intent and delivery.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts, translating performance data into recommendations and QBRs for client leadership.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Enabled a distribution channel of 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail to sell and deliver the product, retaining all but one (~94%).
Led partner onboarding and training, and built automated product-training sequences that scaled enablement across the channel.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own customers.
Fed structured, prioritized field feedback to Product and Engineering, and analyzed partner performance data to recommend interventions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team, and rebuilt internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Pursued a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect through to finalist stage, and served a banking-industry client.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8): set priorities, allocated workload, approved hours and PTO, and oversaw budgets, scope, and delivery.

Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training, and building sales training for tenured account executives.
Standardized the CRM fields required for sales and onboarding workflows, creating consistent data capture across the team.
Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while launching 25+ clients per month.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to implementation teams to execute.
Advised C-suite executives on operational system design and escalated account risk to leadership early; ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15.

experience.title: Co-Owner / Operations Lead
bullets: Built compliance, intake, reporting, and vendor/supplier systems from scratch in a licensed, state-regulated business, scaling it to profitability.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
